title: Cards and Tech View's Assigned Techs show the lead and line technicians
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · Schedule access · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  • Technicians: 4 eligible technicians at this location, named as the expected results name them: "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards", "Dana Ortiz", "Jenny Wilson". A technician is eligible when Time Clock is on, the staff member is active (not deactivated), the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Avatar Group" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset.
  • Work order [WO-1] for this customer: status Approved; Lead Technician Esther Howard; three lines — "Line 1" given to Ralph Edwards, "Line 2" given to Dana Ortiz, "Line 3" with no labor technician; Jenny Wilson holds a Schedule shift on Line 3 (tomorrow 8:00–10:00).
  • What must hold: 4 different people are on [WO-1] (1 lead, 2 line technicians, 1 scheduled technician). The work order number and the line names are examples.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm each technician below exists and is eligible, or add them with New Staff Member: First Name and Last Name ("Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards", "Dana Ortiz", "Jenny Wilson") and an email; a Role that is not Office User or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"); at least one Department (required); Location = this location; Time Clock on > Save & Close.
  2. Top menu Customers > New Customer, Name "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Avatar Group" > Save (skip if it already exists). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Record the customer as [Cust-1].
  3. Create a work order with three lines: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in New Work Order pick Customer [Cust-1] and its Asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line, turn Line Approved on (this makes the work order Approved) > Save & Add Line for the next line or Save & Close. Record the number shown as [WO-1] (e.g. "S1-644"). Line names in this case (such as "Line 1") are only labels for you: the New Line form's "What Are You Doing?" box only offers ready-made lines (typed text finds no results), so pick any ready-made line for each one (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot") and write down which is which.
  4. On [WO-1] pick Lead Technician "Esther Howard". Lead Technician on the work order page is read-only while the work order is an Estimate; once it is Approved it is a Lead Technician dropdown.
  5. Give "Line 1" to Ralph Edwards and "Line 2" to Dana Ortiz (Edit Line > Technicians). Leave "Line 3" with no labor technician.
  6. On the Schedule, give "Jenny Wilson" a shift on [WO-1] tomorrow 8:00–10:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto Jenny Wilson's row at the start time > in the picker choose Choose lines and tick Line 3 > set the end time > save.
  7. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Avatar Group" in Search — exactly [WO-1] shows, Approved, Lead Technician Esther Howard; on its Lines tab Line 1 shows Ralph Edwards, Line 2 Dana Ortiz, Line 3 no labor technician; on the Schedule Jenny Wilson's shift on [WO-1] is there tomorrow. If it does not match, fix the work order (or create it again) before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type [Cust-1] ("ZZAUTOTEST F3 Avatar Group") in Search.
  3. Open Fields to display and turn line technicians on.
  4. Read the avatar group on the card and hover each avatar.
  5. Pick Tech View, open Column Selection and turn Assigned Techs on.
  6. Read the avatar group in the row.
  7. Pick List and open its Column Selection menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The card shows a compact avatar group of 4: Esther Howard (lead) plus Ralph Edwards, Dana Ortiz and Jenny Wilson (the scheduled technician on Line 3 counts as that line's technician).
  • Tech View's Assigned Techs column shows the same 4-avatar group.
  • List does not offer an Assigned Techs column.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10050 (Story 7, Show line technicians on cards and rows); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S7-R1, read 8 Oct 2026. PRD Story 7 context note (scheduled technicians count as the line's technicians). Review Decisions DR-33. Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): List's Columns shows an "Assigned Tech" column; the PRD (no column in List) is followed. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R1: “Board View cards (when the line technicians field is on) and a new optional Assigned Techs column in Tech View show a compact avatar group: the lead technician plus the distinct technicians assigned to work order lines. List does not get this column.”
  • Story 7 context note: “this feature counts technicians scheduled on a line as that line’s technicians (S7-R1).”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
